# Preface {.unnumbered}

![](cover.jpg){width=100% fig-alt="Cover of Civil Procedure by Thomas B. Bennett"}

## About This Book

This book is an introductory text for a first-year law school course in federal civil procedure. It is designed to be flexible, lightweight, and open-access. The materials contained here are left to speak primarily for themselves. Where helpful, secondary materials and my own notes and explanations are appended. A supplement containing the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure, selected federal statutes, and the United States Constitution is included.
